data.name: Maggie's Farmyard Adventure
data.detailed_description:
Explore and share "Maggie’s Farmyard Adventure", part of the Living Books Preschool Success Starter series. Maggie brings the story alive one word at a time, offering an easy to digest story mode which is fully animated and voiced. Increase the fun with interactive games and sing-along songs with lots of bonuses and surprises to discover!

Maggie’s Farmyard Adventure centers around the young, curious, and cheerful Maggie. The story opens with Maggie on a mission to find her cat, where did that cat go? It is nowhere to be found!

Maggie must search scene by scene around the farm to see if she can find it. Along the way, there will be lots of curious interactions, memorable characters, and a chance to meet lots of wonderful farm animals!

Featuring both inspired original and classic musical numbers that keep the fun rolling throughout!

Since it's first release in 1997, Living Books' rendition of "Maggie’s Farmyard Adventure" has been enjoyed by countless children. Step-by-step, the player will discover charming characters, as well as new and fun scenes at every corner. This adventure provides new ways to interact with the story again and again.

  • Both play and story modes suitable for different levels of skill.

  • Interact with the pictures and discover hidden scenes.

  • An easy-to-use point and click interface.

  • Attractive animations bring the characters to life.

  • Fully voiced with charming dialogue and musical numbers!

  • A revitalized re-release compatible with modern platforms.

  • A great way to reward curiosity and engage your child and family.
